description:
Bonobo is an artist who explores elements of instrumental hip-hop, electronica and ambient with live instrumentation and enjoys an illustrious career with a sea of collaborators ranging from Erykah Badu and Andreya Triana to Rhye and Nick Murphy. 

The mix compilation is a playground of house, techno, electronica and breakbeat tracks where character and animated melodies wander and develop, all the while grounded by an acute sense of harmonic progression and rhythmic precision.

The vinyl package is a set of two vinyl plates featuring 15 of the 22 tracks from Bonobo’s opening mix for the new fabric presents series. They are the full unmixed versions including both Bonobo’s exclusive tracks Ibrik and Flicker plus his Boston Common cut previously limited to vinyl only.
